title: Cellar and Room
author: D. M. Eriksen
blurb: Bram Montrose, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
